title: Total Body Climb
description: Push-up pyramid followed by a full-body strength block with lunges, Superman and V-ups

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Brisk marching in place
exercises.instructions: March briskly in place with arm swings

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate rounding and arching the back, breathe

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width apart, body braced, lower your chest to the floor

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate front-left and front-right lunges without pausing

exercises.name: Alternating Superman
exercises.instructions: Lift right arm and left leg, then alternate

exercises.name: V-ups
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, lift arms and legs simultaneously to touch your feet

exercises.name: Hip flexor stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
